name: popover
title: Popover
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A small dialog anchored to its button, raised by the elevation shadow, that returns focus when it closes.

<script lang="ts">
  import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

  let { open = $bindable(false), ...restProps }: PopoverPrimitive.RootProps =
    $props();
</script>

<PopoverPrimitive.Root bind:open {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
  import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    ...restProps
  }: PopoverPrimitive.TriggerProps = $props();
</script>

<PopoverPrimitive.Trigger
  bind:ref
  data-slot="popover-trigger"
  class={cn(className)}
  {...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts" module>
  import { getContext, setContext } from "svelte";

  /**
   * The popover's name. The content provides this context;
   * a title inside it registers its id, and the content is then labelled by
   * the title. Without a title, the content's `label` prop names it.
   */
  export type PopoverContext = {
    /** The id a title takes unless it has its own. */
    readonly titleId: string;
    /** The id of the rendered title, or undefined when there is none. */
    labelledBy: string | undefined;
  };

  const KEY = "pluto:popover";

  export function setPopoverContext(context: PopoverContext): PopoverContext {
    return setContext(KEY, context);
  }

  export function getPopoverContext(): PopoverContext | undefined {
    return getContext<PopoverContext | undefined>(KEY);
  }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
  import { cn, type WithoutChildrenOrChild } from "$UTILS$";
  import PopoverPortal from "./popover-portal.svelte";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    sideOffset = 4,
    align = "center",
    label,
    portalProps,
    ...restProps
  }: PopoverPrimitive.ContentProps & {
    /** The dialog's name when it holds no `PopoverTitle`. One of the two is required. */
    label?: string;
    portalProps?: WithoutChildrenOrChild<ComponentProps<typeof PopoverPortal>>;
  } = $props();

  const uid = $props.id();
  let labelledBy = $state<string | undefined>();
  setPopoverContext({
    titleId: `${uid}-title`,
    get labelledBy() {
      return labelledBy;
    },
    set labelledBy(id) {
      labelledBy = id;
    },
  });
</script>

<!--
  A small dialog raised by elevation alone, which already draws the hairline
  as a spread layer, so no border. 256 px wide by default. The trigger
  promises a dialog (aria-haspopup); the content keeps the promise with
  role="dialog" and a name: its title, else the label prop. Focus inside is
  the global ring. It fades in and out over the micro budget.
-->
<PopoverPortal {...portalProps}>
  <PopoverPrimitive.Content
    bind:ref
    data-slot="popover-content"
    role="dialog"
    aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
    aria-label={labelledBy ? undefined : label}
    {sideOffset}
    {align}
    class={cn(
      "z-50 grid w-3xs origin-(--bits-popover-content-transform-origin) gap-4 rounded bg-popover p-4 text-sm text-popover-foreground shadow-elevation data-open:animate-enter data-closed:animate-exit",
      className,
    )}
    {...restProps}
  />
</PopoverPortal>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

  let { ...restProps }: PopoverPrimitive.PortalProps = $props();
</script>

<PopoverPrimitive.Portal {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
  import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

  let { ref = $bindable(null), ...restProps }: PopoverPrimitive.CloseProps =
    $props();
</script>

<PopoverPrimitive.Close bind:ref data-slot="popover-close" {...restProps} />
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
  import { cn, type WithElementRef } from "$UTILS$";
  import type { HTMLAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
  import { getPopoverContext } from "./popover-content.svelte";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    level = 2,
    id,
    children,
    ...restProps
  }: WithElementRef<HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement>> & {
    /** The heading level: a title that looks like a heading is one. Default 2. */
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
  } = $props();

  const context = getPopoverContext();
  const titleId = $derived(id ?? context?.titleId);

  // The content is labelled by this title while it is rendered.
  $effect(() => {
    if (!context) return;
    context.labelledBy = titleId;
    return () => {
      context.labelledBy = undefined;
    };
  });
</script>

<svelte:element
  this={`h${level}`}
  bind:this={ref}
  id={titleId}
  data-slot="popover-title"
  class={cn("font-heading text-base font-bold", className)}
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</svelte:element>
{@render children?.()}
